# `ecosystem` command

Manage a set of interconnected FoBiS projects: know their state, act across them in dependency
order, release them as a train.

```bash
fobis ecosystem <subcommand> [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Many projects](/cookbook/ecosystem).

## All options

### `fobis ecosystem add`

Register projects in the ecosystem (the [ecosystem] projects list of the user config).

Arguments: `PROJECTS...`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config`, `-c` | TEXT |  | User config file [default: ~/.config/fobis/config.ini] |

### `fobis ecosystem check`

Pre-release impact check: build and test every dependent against PROJECT's local working copy.

Arguments: `PROJECT`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--keep` |  |  | Keep the staged copies even when every check passes |
| `--fail-fast` |  |  | Stop at the first failure |
| `--config`, `-c` | TEXT |  | User config file [default: ~/.config/fobis/config.ini] |

### `fobis ecosystem dashboard`

Show the state of every project: git, release, CI, scaffold drift, dependency pins.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | TEXT | `terminal` | Output format: terminal or html |
| `--output`, `-o` | TEXT |  | HTML file to write [default: ~/.cache/fobis/ecosystem.html] |
| `--no-open` |  |  | Write the HTML page without opening the browser |
| `--no-fetch` |  |  | Skip 'git fetch': faster and offline, but upstream, CI and pins may be old |
| `--no-ci` |  |  | Do not query GitHub Actions (CI shows 'unknown') |
| `--theme` | TEXT |  | HTML palette (see the [ecosystem] theme key) [default: from config, else github] |
| `--mode` | TEXT |  | HTML mode: auto, light or dark [default: from config, else auto] |
| `--jobs`, `-j` | INTEGER | `8` | Projects examined concurrently |
| `--json` |  |  | Print machine-readable JSON instead of text |
| `--config`, `-c` | TEXT |  | User config file [default: ~/.config/fobis/config.ini] |

### `fobis ecosystem discover`

List git repositories with a fobos file under the root that are not registered yet.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--root`, `-r` | TEXT |  | Directory to scan [default: the configured ecosystem root] |
| `--config`, `-c` | TEXT |  | User config file [default: ~/.config/fobis/config.ini] |

### `fobis ecosystem exec`

Run a command in every project, dependencies first: fobis ecosystem exec -- &lt;command&gt;.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--only` | TEXT |  | Comma-separated projects to act on [default: all] |
| `--from` | TEXT |  | Start from this project in release order (resume after a failure) |
| `--fail-fast` |  |  | Stop at the first failure |
| `--config`, `-c` | TEXT |  | User config file [default: ~/.config/fobis/config.ini] |

### `fobis ecosystem fetch`

Run 'fobis fetch --update' in every project with dependencies, dependencies first.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--only` | TEXT |  | Comma-separated projects to act on [default: all] |
| `--from` | TEXT |  | Start from this project in release order (resume after a failure) |
| `--fail-fast` |  |  | Stop at the first failure |
| `--config`, `-c` | TEXT |  | User config file [default: ~/.config/fobis/config.ini] |

### `fobis ecosystem graph`

Print the dependency tree and the release order of the projects.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  |  | Print machine-readable JSON instead of text |
| `--config`, `-c` | TEXT |  | User config file [default: ~/.config/fobis/config.ini] |

### `fobis ecosystem impact`

Which dependent projects a change of PROJECT's public Fortran interfaces breaks, and where.

Arguments: `PROJECT`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--base` | TEXT |  | Compare its working tree with this revision [default: its latest tag, else HEAD] |
| `--format` | TEXT | `text` | text, markdown or json |
| `--deep` |  |  | Add a cited LLM summary for the release train |
| `--deep-context` |  |  | Print what the model would receive for --deep, run no model |
| `--config`, `-c` | TEXT |  | User config file [default: ~/.config/fobis/config.ini] |

### `fobis ecosystem release`

Release train: release every project with releasable commits, dependencies first.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--only` | TEXT |  | Comma-separated projects to act on [default: all] |
| `--from` | TEXT |  | Start from this project in release order (resume after a failure) |
| `--bump` | TEXT |  | Override a bump: NAME=major\|minor\|patch\|vX.Y.Z (repeatable) |
| `--dry-run` |  |  | Show the plan and stop |
| `--yes`, `-y` |  |  | Do not ask: approve the plan and answer each release.sh prompt |
| `--no-fetch` |  |  | Plan without 'git fetch' (not recommended) |
| `--no-wait` |  |  | Do not wait for the GitHub releases |
| `--timeout` | INTEGER | `900` | Seconds to wait for each GitHub release |
| `--config`, `-c` | TEXT |  | User config file [default: ~/.config/fobis/config.ini] |

### `fobis ecosystem remove`

Unregister projects (the repositories themselves are not touched).

Arguments: `PROJECTS...`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--config`, `-c` | TEXT |  | User config file [default: ~/.config/fobis/config.ini] |

### `fobis ecosystem scaffold`

Scaffold drift across the projects (honours each fobos [scaffold] skip).

#### `fobis ecosystem scaffold status`

List the managed files not in sync, project by project (exit 1 when any drifts).

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--only` | TEXT |  | Comma-separated projects to act on [default: all] |
| `--files` | TEXT |  | Limit to managed files matching this glob |
| `--config`, `-c` | TEXT |  | User config file [default: ~/.config/fobis/config.ini] |

#### `fobis ecosystem scaffold sync`

Show (default) or apply the scaffold changes, project by project.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--only` | TEXT |  | Comma-separated projects to act on [default: all] |
| `--files` | TEXT |  | Limit to managed files matching this glob |
| `--apply` |  |  | Write the changes (default: only show them) |
| `--yes`, `-y` |  |  | With --apply: do not ask for each project |
| `--config`, `-c` | TEXT |  | User config file [default: ~/.config/fobis/config.ini] |
